codec_metadata.status: copy-only decoder diagnostic; fresh independent archive-only qualification required

upstream.api_difference_from_squash: Uses buffered Compress/Uncompress; Squash v0.7 invokes CompressStream/UncompressStream.

minimal_decoder_patch.reason: Only replace the two buffered decoder optimized overlap-copy branches (small 64-bit copies and IncrementalCopyFastPath) with bounds-checked IncrementalCopy. ARCH_K8 and all encoder code remain unchanged.

hypothesis: Compact greedy matching and bounded cheap search can improve native FAST throughput; quantify current baseline and same-input codec controls before attribution.
initial_state: Fresh processes; uncontrolled cache and host load; repeated experiments run serially
matched_control: Same original input bytes, host, CPUs16–19 and GNU time method. Imported Squash times are descriptive, never the local speed control.
mechanism: Complete physical archive, selection/discarded-trial time included for automatic CIX; separate standalone reference when explicitly labelled. No filename/content-identity dispatch.
promotion_criteria: Fresh archive-only native restoration exact length and SHA-256, complete archive cost, no loss hidden. Candidate must pass CCA and pipe regressions before Silesia deployment; two repetitions are local screening, not statistical speed qualification.
